intro.heading: A local operator with an insider's Mongolia.
paragraphs: Travels in Mongolia specializes in unforgettable Mongolian tour experiences. We develop sustainable ecotourism and introduce Mongolia's culture, history and wild nature to travelers from around the world.
Founded and led by Doljmaa Songorov, a great expert in Mongolian tourism, our professional team keeps groups small, standards high and logistics invisible — so you're free to simply be present.

story.heading: Built on local roots and hard-won trust.
paragraphs: Travels in Mongolia is a local tour operator specializing in unforgettable Mongolian tour experiences. Since 2011 we have worked directly with the herding families, camp owners, drivers and guides who make each trip possible — no middlemen, no compromises.
Our aim is to develop sustainable ecotourism, deliver overall satisfaction to our customers, and introduce Mongolia's culture, history and wild nature to travelers who care as much as we do.

founder.name: Doljmaa Songorov
founder.text: A great expert in the Mongolian tourism field, Doljmaa personally organizes the tours and oversees the standards our guests rely on. Her decades in the field — and her network across every region — are the reason journeys with us feel effortless and go deeper than most.
founder.quote: We don't sell Mongolia. We introduce you to it, the way we know it.

travelToolsPage.metaDescription: Everything you need to know before you go — visas, timing, packing, health, money and connectivity in Mongolia.

hero.heading: Everything you need to know before you go.

essentials.label: Documents
essentials.title: Visas & entry
essentials.text: Many nationalities enter visa-free for up to 30 days; we'll confirm your requirements and provide any invitation letters needed.

essentials.label: Timing
essentials.title: When to travel
essentials.text: June to September brings green steppe and warm days. October is eagle-festival season. Winter travel is possible for the intrepid.

essentials.label: Packing
essentials.title: What to bring
essentials.text: Layers for wide temperature swings, sturdy footwear, sun protection and a good camera. We send a full packing list on booking.

essentials.label: Health
essentials.title: Staying well
essentials.text: No mandatory vaccinations, but routine ones should be current. We carry first-aid kits and satellite communication on remote routes.

essentials.label: Money
essentials.title: Currency & tipping
essentials.text: The local currency is the tögrög. Carry some cash for remote areas; cards work in Ulaanbaatar. Tipping is appreciated, never expected.

essentials.label: Connectivity
essentials.title: Staying in touch
essentials.text: Mobile coverage is good near towns and patchy in the wild. We provide satellite contact on all remote departures.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: For festival departures and peak summer we recommend six to nine months. Tailored private trips can often be arranged with less notice — get in touch and we'll advise honestly.

faqs.question: Are your trips private or group?
faqs.answer: Both. Most journeys are run privately just for you, at your own pace. We also offer a limited number of small-group departures each year on fixed dates.

faqs.question: What is the accommodation like?
faqs.answer: A mix of comfortable hotels in Ulaanbaatar and authentic tourist ger camps in the countryside — real Mongolian felt tents with proper beds, and shared or private facilities depending on the camp.

faqs.question: Is Mongolia suitable for families or older travelers?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, driving distances and activity levels to your group. Tell us about your travelers and we'll design accordingly.

faqs.question: How do payments and deposits work?
faqs.answer: A deposit secures your dates, with the balance due before travel. We'll set out clear terms in writing before anything is confirmed.

faqs.question: Can you arrange flights within Mongolia?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — domestic flights to the Gobi, west and north are built into many itineraries and we handle all the booking for you.
